title: SEC2: download handler buffers full blob in memory
description: blob_download_handler calls BlobStore::read_blob which uses tokio::fs::read() — this reads the entire file into a Vec<u8> before building the response. For a 100 MiB attachment this allocates 100 MiB of heap on every download request. Fix: replace read_blob with a streaming path using tokio::fs::File opened with ReaderStream (tokio_util::io::ReaderStream) so axum streams bytes directly from disk without buffering. BlobStore::read_blob API would need a companion read_blob_stream method, or the handler can open the file directly via blob_path().
